title: Role-Aware Server Optimization for Multimodal Federated Learning with Missing Modalities
abstract: arXiv:2610.41193v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Multimodal federated learning (MFL) trains a shared model by aggregating client updates without exchanging raw data. Under missing modalities, clients adapt active modality encoders and a shared prediction block (fusion and classifier) to different input subsets. This raises two server-side questions: which clients should contribute to each component, and how should their aggregates be incorporated across rounds? We observe that an absent-modality encoder can still adapt through missing-input handling. Availability- based aggregation can therefore omit its update while retaining jointly learned prediction-block updates. Contributor selection also shapes server momentum, a weighted history of aggregated updates. We observe that prediction-block momentum can improve or reduce performance depending on the encoder update policy. We therefore propose Role-Aware Server Optimization (RASO), which coordinates contributor selection with role-spec

translated_title: 面向模态缺失多模态联邦学习的角色感知服务器优化
translated_abstract: 多模态联邦学习（MFL）通过聚合客户端更新来训练共享模型，而无需交换原始数据。在模态缺失的情况下，客户端会针对不同的输入子集对活跃模态编码器以及一个共享的预测模块（融合与分类器）进行自适应调整。这引出了两个服务器端的问题：哪些客户端应为每个组件做出贡献，以及它们的聚合结果应如何在各轮训练之间被纳入？我们观察到，缺失模态的编码器仍然可以通过缺失输入处理机制进行自适应调整。因此，基于可用性的聚合可以省略该编码器的更新，同时保留联合学习的预测模块更新。贡献者选择还会影响服务器动量，即聚合更新的加权历史。我们观察到，预测模块动量可能改善也可能降低性能，这取决于编码器的更新策略。因此，我们提出了角色感知服务器优化（RASO），它将贡献者选择与角色特定的……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出角色感知服务器优化（RASO），在模态缺失的多模态联邦学习场景下，通过协调贡献者选择与角色特定的聚合策略来决定各组件应纳入哪些客户端的更新，从而提升模型性能。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes Role-Aware Server Optimization (RASO), which coordinates contributor selection with role-specific aggregation strategies to determine which clients' updates are incorporated for each model component, improving multimodal federated learning under missing modalities.
